from datetime import datetime

# login simple_note
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_map={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in creds}

sn_access=apis.simple_note.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])['access_token']

note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=836, access_token=sn_access)
content=note['content']
print('today', datetime.now().strftime('%A'))
print('note title', note['title'])

# map weekday to note key
weekday=datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
# simple_note uses 'day: monday' etc
# Extract duration_mins for the matching day block
import re

pattern=re.compile(r"day:\s*"+re.escape(weekday)+r"\n(?:.*\n)*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", re.IGNORECASE)
match=pattern.search(content)
if match:
    duration_mins=int(match.group(1))
    print('duration_mins', duration_mins)
else:
    # fallback: parse blocks more robustly
    print('pattern failed')
    raise SystemExit('Could not find today duration in note')

from datetime import datetime
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_map={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in creds}
spotify_access=apis.spotify.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=pass_map['spotify'])['access_token']
# get playlists library (all pages)
all_playlists=[]
page=0
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_access, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    page+=1
    if page>50:
        break

print('playlists', [(p['playlist_id'], p['title']) for p in all_playlists])

# get workout duration from simple note note 836
sn_access=apis.simple_note.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])['access_token']
content=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=836, access_token=sn_access)['content']
weekday=datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
import re
match=re.search(r"day:\s*"+re.escape(weekday)+r"\n(?:.*\n)*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
workout_mins=int(match.group(1))
workout_seconds=workout_mins*60
print('workout_mins', workout_mins, 'workout_seconds', workout_seconds)

# compute total duration per playlist
playlist_durations=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=spotify_access)
    total=sum([s.get('duration',0) for s in pl.get('songs',[])])
    playlist_durations.append((p['playlist_id'], pl['title'], len(pl.get('songs',[])), total))
    print('playlist', pl['title'], 'songs', len(pl.get('songs',[])), 'total_duration', total)

# choose playlist that meets workout duration; pick smallest total >= workout_seconds
candidates=[x for x in playlist_durations if x[3] >= workout_seconds]
print('candidates', candidates)
if not candidates:
    # if none meet, pick playlist with max total duration
    chosen=max(playlist_durations, key=lambda x: x[3])
    print('no candidates; chosen max', chosen)
else:
    chosen=min(candidates, key=lambda x: x[3])
    print('chosen', chosen)

chosen_playlist_id=chosen[0]
chosen_title=chosen[1]
print('chosen_title', chosen_title)

# Start workout playlist on Spotify with enough songs
from datetime import datetime

# get passwords
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_map={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in creds}

# login to spotify
spotify_access=apis.spotify.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=pass_map['spotify'])['access_token']

# clear existing queue to avoid needing to change mid-workout
clear_res=apis.spotify.clear_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access)
print('clear_song_queue', clear_res)

# play chosen playlist (computed earlier as enough for 45 min workout)
playlist_id=183
play_res=apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=spotify_access, playlist_id=playlist_id)
print('play_music', play_res)

# verify queue now
queue=apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access)
print('queue_count', len(queue) if isinstance(queue, list) else queue)
if isinstance(queue, list):
    # print first few to confirm current
    print('first_items', [(q.get('position'), q.get('title'), q.get('is_current'), q.get('is_playing')) for q in queue[:5]])

# complete supervisor task (no answer needed)
complete_res=apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None)
print('complete_task', complete_res)
